shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat package.json app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts; printf '\\nDocs matches:\\n'; rg -l 'after\\(' node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -50; printf '\\nNested instructions:\\n'; find app -name AGENTS.md -print; printf '\\nGit status:\\n'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/after.md; printf '\\nConnection docs:\\n'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md; printf '\\nAvailable local dirs:\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' | head -100; printf '\\nTS config:\\n'; cat tsconfig.json; printf '\\nNext config docs metadata:\\n'; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/01-installation.md 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '92,230p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/after.md; sed -n '1,84p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md; sed -n '1,100p' AGENTS.md; ls -la __agent_eval__; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions | rg '/(io|after|connection)\\.md'"
